ratings_why.fun: A clear curve: stats pool into one champion early, shop and enemy duels bring in new stats mid-game, and Pilgrim or Ottokar give a big finish worth climbing to.
ratings_why.distinct: One size-comparison verb used on your board, the shop and the enemy, plus empty slots as the stage and losing on purpose to buy the winner, plays unlike today's tribes.

verdict_why: Each tier does its job and v3 cleared the rules gaps; what remains is heat for the owner's balance pass, not something to fix.

points.text: Turns 1-3 mostly move stats around your own board, and Pennon-Bearer is the only early fight body. A Tier 1 shop-duel seed would let the Raiding line start on turn 2 and give the early game real gains.
Lord of the Old Lek fixes hero damage for a lone champion, but the wider side still attacks first. Letting a lone doubled champion attack first would finish the few-knights fantasy.

Pilgrim with Keeper of the Gizzard Stones and Cantor takes well over a hundred stats a turn from the shop. It is limited by shop size, not self-feeding, so leave it hot; the refresh cap is the dial if needed.
Ottokar with Keeper and Cantor shrinks most of the enemy board to a quarter before any attack. The counterplay is one tall enemy he won't challenge, which keeps it fair enough for now.
Squire Konrad is a neat feeder that never empties. Making his golden also duel twice would give the Lone Champion line a triple worth chasing early.

standouts.why: Edge-Strutter makes losing a duel a real play: let a shop unit win, then buy it bigger.
Lord of the Old Lek turns empty slots into power and damage, a payoff no other tribe has.
Pilgrim from Sprucehold is a capstone the shop build is clearly built to reach.

weakest.why: Keeper of the Gizzard Stones is a pure multiplier with no use until duels are already flowing.
Bristle-Beard Rival duels attackers that are often bigger, so it can feed the enemy.
Dawn Herald backfires against a tall enemy carry, so it is hard to trust at Tier 4.

flags.note: With Keeper and Cantor, three passes over the whole shop each turn go far past the Tier 6 ceiling.
With Keeper and Cantor he may decide fights at Start of Combat against any wide board.
Golden Elder of the Centre with Grit Pit Elder's fight wins and Konrad's gains doubles every feeder into the champion.
